Container.Name: subscriberr
Container.Overview: Tracks and enforces paid access to Plex and Jellyfin libraries for members who pay by Interac e-Transfer. Reads e-Transfer notices from Gmail, matches payments to members, extends due dates, grants/revokes library access and sends reminders. Put it behind Nginx Proxy Manager (Network: the NPM Docker network) and open it through its https:// address.
Container.Requires: Build the image first: docker build -t subscriberr . (in a clone of the repository). Map /backups to a different disk than /data.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Container port 3000. Leave EMPTY when NPM reaches the container over the shared Docker network (recommended: a published port bypasses NPM's TLS and lets clients spoof their IP address). Not needed when NPM reaches the container over the shared Docker network; publish it only for a LAN test (secure cookies need https, so sign in through the NPM address).

Config.Name: Data (appdata)
Config.Description: Database, custom template packs, logos, import staging.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Nightly verified backups. MUST be a different share/disk than appdata (not the same cache SSD). Include it in your off-box backup. Backups are not encrypted.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public URL people type. Used for the Google OAuth redirect, secure cookies and email links.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: true behind Nginx Proxy Manager (one hop). 2 if Cloudflare's proxy (orange cloud) is also in front of NPM.

Config.Name: APP_SECRET
Config.Description: REQUIRED, at least 32 random characters. Encrypts stored Google and media-server credentials. Keep a copy in your password manager: backups do NOT include it.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Google OAuth client id (README: Google sign-in).

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAILS
Config.Description: Recommended: your Gmail address. Only these accounts can become the Owner of a fresh install; comma-separated.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Server timezone (nightly backup time, default workspace timezone).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the files in /data and /backups (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the files in /data and /backups (Unraid: 100 = users).
